held.title: Queries may be template-interpolated twice, applying ad-hoc filters twice.
held.body: The queries are now passed through `applyTemplateVariables(query, request.scopedVars, request.filters)` before splitting, but the sub-requests still go through `datasource.runQuery`. If that ends in `DataSourceWithBackend.query`, it calls `applyTemplateVariables` on every target again with the same `request.filters`. The second pass then adds the ad-hoc filters again: for queries with a parser, `addAdHocFilters` adds another `| key="value"` stage, and selectors may get duplicate matchers. A variable value that contains `$...` would also be expanded again. I could not see `runQuery`, so I could not confirm the second pass. If it happens, clear `filters` on the sub-requests, or mark the targets as already interpolated so they are not interpolated again. The same applies to `runShardSplitQuery` in shardQuerySplitting.ts.
